turns.content: Yaar meri shaadi mein six weeks bache hain. Rohan ko haldi mein hona hai, toast bhi dena hai — first year college se mera bhai hai. Par jab bhi Bangalore se travel ki baat karta hoon, bas "dekhte hain yaar, pakka try karunga." Main khud hi uski flight book kar doon kya, khatam jhanjhat?

Arre yaar, samajh aa raha hai tension. Shaadi ke last weeks mein yeh "dekhte hain" wala reply sunna irritating ho jata hai, especially jab woh banda first-year se bhai jaisa ho aur uska haldi + toast dono important ho.

Agar tujhe genuinely uska hona chahiye, toh haan, khud book kar de. Ek simple message daal: "Yaar main book kar raha hoon, tu bas aa ja. Ticket confirm hai." Zyadatar log uss point pe "haan bhai aa raha hoon" bol dete hain kyunki ab unhe sochna nahi padta.

Bas ek cheez dhyan rakhna – pehle casually confirm kar le ki uske dates free hain ya koi last-minute official commitment toh nahi. Warna ticket waste ho jayegi aur mood kharab.

Tu tension mat le, jo log genuinely chahte hain woh aa jaate hain. Aur agar nahi aaye toh bhi teri shaadi toh mast hone wali hai. Bol, kya soch raha hai exactly?

Maine check kiya, nau hazaar ki return flight hai, koi bada amount nahi. Usne do mahine pehle job switch kiya, koi startup hai. Aur aajkal uske replies bhi two-word aate hain, pehle voice notes bhejta tha. Bol raha hoon khud ko ki busy hoga, par hafton se yahi chal raha hai.

Arre yaar, 9k wala ticket itna bada nahi hai, especially shaadi ke liye. Startup wali job switch ke baad busy hona normal hai, pehle 2-3 mahine toh log literally drown ho jaate hain. Voice notes se two-word replies pe aana ussi ka sign ho sakta hai — overload, nahi ki tujhse door ho raha hai.

Agar tu genuinely chahta hai woh aaye, toh book kar de aur casually bol: “Yaar ticket book kar diya, tu bas aa ja, koi tension nahi.” Zyadatar log uss point pe haan kar dete hain kyunki ab unhe sochna nahi padta.

Bas pehle ek baar casually dates confirm kar le (call ya voice note se, text se nahi). Agar woh genuinely nahi aa sakta toh bhi teri shaadi toh mast hi hogi. Tu tension mat le, jo log genuinely chahte hain woh aa jaate hain.

Bol, ab kya soch raha hai exactly? Book karne ka plan hai ya pehle ek baar usse baat karega?

Sach bolun toh ab bura lagne laga hai. Agar sach mein care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta na? Soch raha hoon aaj raat call karke seedha puchh loon — "bhai aa raha hai ya nahi, haan ya na." Kam se kam pata toh chalega main kahan khada hoon.

Haan yaar, ab bura lagna bilkul natural hai. Jab koi first-year se bhai jaisa ho aur shaadi ke itne important moments ke liye itna vague rahe, toh dil pe padta hai. “Agar care karta toh pehle din haan bol deta” wala sochna bhi samajh aa raha hai.

Aaj raat call karna accha idea hai. Seedha puchh le, lekin thoda soft rakhna taaki woh defensive na ho jaye. Kuch aisa bol sakta hai: “Bhai, main tension le raha hoon isliye seedha puchh raha hoon. Haldi aur toast ke liye tera hona meri taraf se bahut important hai. Tu aa payega ya nahi? Bas haan ya na bol de, main accordingly plan kar lunga.”

Isse tujhe clarity mil jayegi aur usko bhi pata chalega ki tu seriously wait kar raha hai. Startup + naya job wale log kabhi-kabhi itne overwhelm ho jaate hain ki woh realize hi nahi kar paate ki unka delay doosre ko kitna feel ho raha hai. Shayad woh genuinely try kar raha ho, bas bol nahi paa raha.

Jo bhi jawab aaye, tu theek rahega. Teri shaadi toh phir bhi mast hone wali hai. Call ke baad bataio kya hua, main yahin hoon.

Meri fiancée bol rahi hai main overthink kar raha hoon, woh bas busy hoga. Par yeh wahi banda hai jo 2019 mein meri behen ki shaadi ke liye overnight bus se aaya tha. Kuch toh badla hai aur samajh nahi aa raha kya, aur haldi se do hafte pehle main usse naraaz baitha hoon, yeh feeling hi ganda hai.

Haan yaar, 2019 wala overnight bus wala Rohan aur aaj ka “dekhte hain” wala Rohan — yeh contrast hi sabse zyada chubh raha hai. Woh pehle wala version tere liye itna effort karta tha ki ab yeh vague replies aur two-word texts lag rahe hain jaise koi aur insaan ho gaya. Fiancée kehte hain overthink kar raha hai, busy hoga, lekin tu jo feel kar raha hai woh valid hai. Kisi ke liye itna important hona aur phir suddenly distance feel hona, especially shaadi ke itne close, naturally ganda lagta hai.

Aaj raat wala call accha hai. Seedha puchh le, lekin usse yeh mat feel hone dena ki tu usse blame kar raha hai. Bas clarity maang. “Bhai, main confuse ho gaya hoon. Pehle tu overnight aa jaata tha, ab itna vague. Haldi aur toast ke liye tera hona meri taraf se bahut matter karta hai. Tu aa payega ya nahi? Bas haan ya na bol de.” Itna kaafi hai. Uske jawab se tujhe pata chal jayega kahan khada hai.

Jo bhi ho, tu usse naraaz baith ke apna mood kharab mat kar. Teri shaadi tere haath mein hai, uske aane na aane se nahi. Call ke baad jo bhi hua, bata dena. Main yahin hoon.
